title: Midnight coffee
content:

Bises!

title: Dead-end
content:
Hello. I created this blog to track my activities—just the things I do for fun.
"I’m going to play with physics," said Dr. Feynman,"…without worrying about any importance whatsoever. I’m just doing it for the fun of it."
For the past two months, I haven't attended medical school because I failed two subjects that, honestly, aren't all that important. But due to the rules, I have to wait to find another university to retake the exams.
At first, I thought, "Well, I can use this time to enhance my coding skills."
But I didn’t do much of that either.
I really believe this phase will pass, and I’ll get back on track—studying, coding, and learning French.
But over these last two months, I feel like I’ve accomplished nothing. What if I never make it? What if I never become as great as I dream? I didn’t try hard enough—neither for exams, nor for coding, nor for anything.
What if doing it for fun isn’t enough anymore? What if what it takes to be as great as my dreams isn’t just doing it for fun, but working way harder than I’ll ever be capable of? What if I can never stick to the plans?
Will I ever become the hardworking, focused person I need to be?
Stay tuned to this blog, and you'll see if I make it. :)
But for now, I feel very blue.
